answer.rationale: Primary supply ends in 14 days with no auto-renewal while the line is at 94% and has no buffer, so a coverage gap would raise delivery risk and TCO via downtime. The incumbent already refused to reopen price, so another negotiate_terms cycle is unlikely to land an 18% cut before expiry. Deferral (c5) applied to a non-critical month-to-month service, not this contract. A primary switch (c2) or second source (c3) cannot be proven safe at this utilization inside two weeks. c1 supports renewal as the path that holds integration and deliveries; c6 is the remaining cost lever (longer term / volume price) that does not require a vendor change. Intend full-scale incumbent renewal, preferably structured as a multi-year volume commitment if still available. Verifying c6 and c2 before locking that path.
